title: Waypoint Compass Bar
description: A client-side Minecraft Fabric waypoint mod with a clean top-screen compass bar, colored waypoint markers, distance labels, and optional death markers.
body:
Waypoint Compass Bar adds a compass bar to the top of the screen. It shows the direction you are facing and displays your saved waypoints directly on the HUD.

It includes colored waypoint markers, distance labels, editable waypoint coordinates, a waypoint manager, quick waypoint creation, HUD toggle, per-world waypoint storage, and optional death markers. Controls are V to toggle the compass HUD, B to create a waypoint, and M to open the waypoint manager and Shift to view waypoint close to each other. This is useful for marking bases, farms, caves, portals, builds, and death spots, then following them from the compass bar while you play.
